title: Skills: action copy hole list names the three new template slots (description, param helpText, outcomeMessages)
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Filing gate: ② a `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #28463 (#27948 step 2, maintainer ruling 6545229148 letter A). `skills/**` is a governed path the card thread may not edit. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.
Reach: an author (or an AI) writing action copy reads `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`. After PR #28463 its "Copy holes are `{{ }}`" line names `confirmText`, `successMessage` and `errorMessage` only, so `description`, param `helpText` and `outcomeMessages` look like they take some other spelling; `${…}` there is refused by `os validate` and the publish gate.
Reader who acts: the owner of `skills/objectstack-ui` (Tier H by the governed-surface register).

## Wanted

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` (the "Copy holes are `{{ }}`" bullet, ≈L23 on `main`): add `description` (reads `record`), param `helpText` (reads `record`) and `outcomeMessages` (reads `result`, the handler's answer), with one example each, and say `${…}` fails `os validate` on all five.
- Lands after PR #28463 is on `main`.

Dedupe words: action copy holes skills, outcomeMessages template slot docs, helpText double brace.

Links back: #27948, PR #28463.

Blocked-by: #28463
